changes: Released 2026-11-25 (XC_VM-GO, unofficial fork based on XC_VM 2.7.4).
Go is now the default for live channels: every plain copy-to-HLS live channel runs on the Go engine (ffmpeg-golive), no list to maintain.
/home/xc_vm/config/golive_streams.txt: * = all (default), stream ids = only those, empty = all live channels on FFmpeg. Channels switch at their next (re)start, including restarts from the panel.
FFmpeg is still used automatically for transcoding, filters, logos, encrypted HLS / fMP4 and several outputs.
Includes everything from 2.7.4-p2: Go replaces FFmpeg for all on-demand channels, go badge and on-demand stats in the panel, panel settings drive the Go engine.
